Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You close your fist, and the air falls with the thunder.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
Every creature in a visible 3-by-3 area within 6 squares.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Attack

Call a crack of lightning followed by a collapsing wall of air. Make one roll using the net Boons or Banes least favorable to you among the targets; include allies.

Weak
4 lightning damage.
Standard
4 lightning damage and push 1 away from the center.
Strong
6 lightning damage and push 2; the center target’s direction is your choice.

For a target standing in the center square, choose its push direction before resolving the displacement.
